title: In-match quick messages
one_line: Canned phrases fired from the right button of the match action bar. Deliberately not free-text chat - the reason is below.

design_decision.what: Quick messages (a fixed list of phrases), not a free-text chat box.
design_decision.why: Free text between strangers needs moderation, reporting, blocking and an age gate before it can ship. Google Play's Families policy and Apple's 1.2 rule both treat unmoderated user-to-user text as a rejection risk, and a casual Ludo game gets abuse in the first week. A fixed phrase list is shippable today, translates for free (the strings are ours), and is what Ludo King and Parchisi actually do.
design_decision.later: Free text can be added for accepted friends only, once Phase C ships, with a report and block flow. Do not build it before then.
design_decision.owner_can_override: If the owner wants free text now, say this cost once and build it - but it must come with report, block and a profanity filter in the same task.

anatomy.spec: None. Tray, not popup. The board stays visible and the match keeps running.
Small NX Card (rim 6, rivets), 356 wide, slides up from the action bar's right button. Bottom edge tucks behind the bar.
Segmented control (bible 5.10), two segments: FRIENDLY / REACTIONS. Three at most - do not add a third without the owner.
Phrase rows (bible 5.7), cream plates, radius 14, 48 tall, 8 pt gap. Text Lilita 17 Title Case ink.default, left aligned with 16 pt inset. Tapping a row fires it and closes the tray.
An incoming message renders as a bubble over the sender's player card for 2.2 s - the same slot the emotes use, so the two never overlap. Queue them if they collide.
Second tap on the button, or a tap on the board. No close X.

states: Open - tray up, both tabs reachable.
Cooling down - rows go to the disabled kind, header shows 'Wait 5s'.
Unread - notification dot on the action bar's message button; opening the tray clears it.
Muted sender - nothing renders. No bubble, no dot, no sound.
Pass and Play - the message button is hidden entirely. Everyone is holding the same phone.
motion: Open: slide up 200 ms ease-out-back. Close: 140 ms ease-in.
Fire: row press 80/140 ms, tray closes, bubble rises over the sender's card, holds 2.2 s, fades 200 ms.
Cooldown: 5 s, longer than emotes because text lands harder. Radial wipe on the tray header.
data: Phrase list: a ScriptableObject or a const table in MatchMessageTray.cs. Live strings, never baked art, so other languages can be added later.
Mute list: shared with match-emoji-tray - one mute covers both.
Delivery: local today. Moves to the server with the match state at T-D2.
do_not: Do not build a free-text input. See design_decision above.
Do not dim the board or add a close X.
Do not let a message bubble and an emote bubble occupy the same card slot at once - queue them.
Do not show the message button in Pass and Play.

Do not put anything in the phrase list that can be used as an insult with a straight face. 'Too slow' and 'Give up' do not ship. Every phrase must be readable as good-natured by the person receiving it.
acceptance: Tray opens and closes from the action bar's right button and never covers the board centre.
Both tabs work; every phrase fires and shows over the sender's card for 2.2 s.
The 5 s cooldown visibly locks the list.
Muting a player stops both their messages and their emotes.
Unread dot appears on the button and clears when the tray opens.
The message button is absent in Pass and Play.
steps: 1. Preflight per SHARED_RULES.md section 2. If the owner has asked for free text, restate the moderation cost once, then follow their decision.
2. Put the phrase list in one place as live strings. Two tabs, six phrases each.
3. Build the tray prefab: small-card chassis, segmented control, phrase rows.
4. Wire it to the action bar's right button, sharing the bubble slot and the mute list with the emoji tray.
5. Implement the 5 s cooldown and the unread dot.
6. Hide the button in Pass and Play.
7. Capture open, cooling-down and received states. Postflight.
prompt:
Build the in-match quick-message tray for Ludo NX.

Read SCREEN_PLANS/specs/SHARED_RULES.md, SCREEN_PLANS/specs/MATCH_HUD_V2.md section 3.4, and this whole file. Use only values from UI_BIBLE/tokens.json.

IMPORTANT, read the 'design_decision' field before you start: this is a fixed list of canned phrases, NOT a free-text chat box. Free text between strangers needs moderation, reporting and blocking before it can pass store review, and a casual Ludo game attracts abuse immediately. A phrase list ships today, translates for free, and is what the competition actually does. Free text can come later, for accepted friends only, once Phase C is live.

It is a TRAY like the emoji tray: no scrim, no close X, the board stays visible. Small NX Card chassis sliding up from the action bar's right button, a two-segment control (FRIENDLY / REACTIONS), and six phrase rows per tab. Tapping a row fires it and closes the tray; the message appears as a bubble over the sender's player card for 2.2 seconds, sharing the bubble slot with emotes so the two never overlap.

Cooldown is 5 seconds - longer than emotes, because text lands harder. The mute list is shared with the emoji tray: one mute covers both. Hide the button entirely in Pass and Play.

Every phrase in the list must read as good-natured to the person receiving it. Nothing that works as an insult.

Follow the 'steps' array. Finish with bible section 11 and the 'acceptance' list.
